prompt: A seven-panel photo strip of the same canal lock keeper's hut, panels side by side left to right. Each panel is numbered 1 to 7 in its top-left corner and carries a small enamel board with two printed lines: "BOATS THROUGH" followed by a number, and "GATE JAMMED" followed by either YES or NO. In panel order the BOATS THROUGH numbers are 4, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, and GATE JAMMED reads YES in panels 2, 4, 5, 6 and NO in panels 1, 3, 7. Now the rule about the signal arm. It is raised only in the panels where BOTH of these are true at the same time -- first, the running total of boats through since the first panel, counting that panel's own board, is an odd number; and second, the number of panels so far in which the gate jammed, counting that panel's own board, is an even number (none at all counts as even). Where it is raised it is drawn pointing steeply upwards; in every other panel it is drawn lying flat and horizontal. Both conditions must hold together; either one on its own is not enough. I am deliberately not listing the answer anywhere in this request; work it out from the figures printed in the picture.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show a strip of separate numbered panels in a row, each panel carrying a small board with two printed lines of text on it. Ignoring artistic quality, and ignoring whether the details are right or wrong, does the image DEPICT that? Answer NO only if the picture is unrelated to that description or contains no such arrangement at all. Answer yes or no only.

Copy each line exactly as it appears, character by character. Do NOT correct spelling or arithmetic and do not leave any line out. Separate the lines with spaces.
reference.count_noun: a numbered panel of the strip
reference.qa: This picture is a strip of 7 separate panels in a single row, numbered 1 to 7. Go through the panels in order from panel 1 to panel 7. For EACH panel report three things joined by spaces: first the number printed on that panel's board beside BOATS THROUGH, then the word YES or NO exactly as printed on that panel's board beside GATE JAMMED, then one word — RAISED if the signal arm in that panel is pointing steeply upwards, or LOWERED if it is lying flat and horizontal. Judge every panel on its own — the panels do not have to agree with one another, and the same answer may come up several times in a row. Give exactly 7 answers separated by semicolons, in panel order, and nothing else. ...'.

Give exactly 7 answers separated by semicolons, in panel order, and nothing else.
